title: A lane per fix: a smaller model builds, a stronger model reviews, I decide
desc: Lanes from this repo, one column each, merging into the shared code (main). Rows are model tiers, bottom to top: smallest model (Haiku), smaller model (Sonnet), stronger model (Opus 5.5), and the coordinator (Fable), where I make the calls. Grey boxes build; green boxes review the work one tier up; the coordinator's review is a white outline. Haiku mined the source inventory and merged. Sonnet mined the experiments and the pivots; Opus reviewed each (top-3, pivots) before merge. Opus wrote the synthesis plan; the coordinator reviewed it before merge.
